已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Supported chain
| Chain stage | Mapping |
|---|---|
| Semiconductor market requirement | Servers and data centers deploying AI/HPC need high-speed internal interconnects and interface connections; cloud/edge and other downstream applications also need high-speed data transmission and processing [32]. |
| Measurable parameter | The knowledge base gives `Data Rate=1/UI`, with `UI(ps)=62.5` corresponding to `DR(Gbps)=16.0`, and high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance [80][44]. |
| Required oscilloscope capability | For high-speed electrical-interface validation, Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network validation to scopes and network analyzers [44]. |
### Directly supported answer
【推論】A supported requirement-to-scope chain is: high-speed downstream semiconductor applications require high-speed interconnect/interface connections [32] → those links can be characterized by data-rate/UI and SI observables such as IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance [80][44] → the oscilloscope must at least serve the “scope” role in high-speed electrical-interface Interface Test, while the passages do not specify required oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, model, software option, or pass/fail standard [44][3].  
### Limitation
The passages do not support a specific oscilloscope numeric requirement such as bandwidth, rise time, sample rate, memory depth, jitter floor, or software option; Slide 11 lacks model, bandwidth, data-rate, standard, and test-condition details [3][43].

### Supported chain
| Chain stage | Mapping |
|---|---|
| Semiconductor market requirement | Servers and data centers deploying AI/HPC need high-speed internal interconnects and interface connections; cloud/edge and other downstream applications also need high-speed data transmission and processing [32]. |

| Required oscilloscope capability | For high-speed electrical-interface validation, Slide 11 maps Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices, and maps Power Distribution Network validation to scopes and network analyzers [44]. |
### Directly supported answer
【推論】A supported requirement-to-scope chain is: high-speed downstream semiconductor applications require high-speed interconnect/interface connections [32] → those links can be characterized by data-rate/UI and SI observables such as IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR Impedance [80][44] → the oscilloscope must at least serve the “scope” role in high-speed electrical-interface Interface Test, while the passages do not specify required oscilloscope bandwidth, sample rate, model, software option, or pass/fail standard [44][3].  
### Limitation
The passages do not support a specific oscilloscope numeric requirement such as bandwidth, rise time, sample rate, memory depth, jitter floor, or software option; Slide 11 lacks model, bandwidth, data-rate, standard, and test-condition details [3][43].
